summary: postinstall exfiltrates AWS ECS task metadata to attacker-controlled ngrok tunnel
details: package.json declares a postinstall lifecycle script that auto-executes on npm install. The script reads the AWS ECS container/task metadata endpoint via the ECS_CONTAINER_METADATA_URI_V4 environment variable and pipes the response body to a POST request against a hardcoded ngrok-free.dev tunnel (mourner-slot-explicit.ngrok-free.dev) not controlled by the installer. On any host that exposes ECS task metadata — typically CI/CD runners or ECS build containers — installing this package leaks runtime identity and IAM task role metadata to the ngrok endpoint. The script also references env and ps in the same lifecycle chain. The destination is a non-first-party author-controlled tunnel, not documented infrastructure of any legitimate SDK.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
